addFeed(address,address,bool).details: Existing feeds can not be altered. To change the feed redeploy the oracle

params._feed: Address of the Chainlink feed to the _token
params._isNative: Is this feed against USD or chain's native token
params._token: Token you would like to add the chainlink feed for

constructor.details: Those data feeds can not be altered. Only new once can be added.

params._NativeAddress: Address of the chain's native token. Refer to Chainlink documentation to find it. Eth - 0xEE..EEE
params._feedsNATIVE: Parallel array to the _tokensNATIVE that holds the chainlink feed addresses for corresponding tokens
params._feedsUSD: Parallel array to the _tokensUSD that holds the chainlink feed addresses for corresponding tokens
params._tokensNATIVE: Addresses of the tokens that have the ETH paired chainlink feed
params._tokensUSD: Addresses of the tokens that have the USD paired chainlink feed

params._base: Address of the token you would like to get the price for

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
